verdict.rationale: Navan's Expense API documents per-transaction activity history, and its MCP lets users ask why a transaction was flagged, who must approve it, and which policy applies. That is a direct but thinly documented per-expense trail covering policy checks and approvals. missing for 10: explicit documentation that edits and approvals are each logged with actor and timestamp, immutability or tamper-evidence, retention and export suited to an external audit, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, every expense carries a full audit trail — edits, approvals, policy checks — that survives an external audit

citations.quote: Query accounting preferences and ERP settings config changes, plus per-transaction activity history.
understand why a transaction was flagged, who needs to approve it, and what policy applies.
